function.name: exec
function.description: Run JavaScript in the agent execution environment. The code can call the tools exposed on tools, inspect ALL_TOOLS, and emit results with text, image, or audio. Long-running execution can return a cell ID to resume with wait. Preserve the execution environment used by the recorded trajectory.

function.name: wait
function.description: Resume a running exec cell using its returned cell ID. Returns new output or completion.

function.name: sleep
function.description: Pause the agent execution environment for the specified duration.
